questions.text: What kind of home do you live in?
questions.say: Good evening. My name is Lily, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your home. What kind of home do you live in?

questions.text: Do you know many people in your building or street?
questions.say: Do you know many people in your building or street?

questions.text: Is there anything you don't like about your home?
questions.say: Is there anything you don't like about your home?

questions.text: Would you like to live somewhere else in the future?
questions.say: Would you like to live somewhere else in the future?

questions.text: What was your favourite subject at school?
questions.say: Now let's move on to talk about school subjects. What was your favourite subject at school?

questions.text: Which subject did you find most difficult?
questions.say: Which subject did you find most difficult?

questions.text: Do you think schools teach the right subjects?
questions.say: Do you think schools teach the right subjects?

questions.text: When do you find it hard to concentrate?
questions.say: Now let's move on to talk about concentration. When do you find it hard to concentrate?

questions.text: Is it easier for you to concentrate in the morning or in the evening?
questions.say: Is it easier for you to concentrate in the morning or in the evening?

cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you saw a beautiful sky.
cueCard.explain: and explain why you remember it.

questions.text: Describe a time when you saw a beautiful sky.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you saw a beautiful sky. You should say: when and where it was; what the sky looked like; who you were with; and explain why you remember it.

questions.text: Did you take a photograph of it?
questions.say: Thank you. Did you take a photograph of it?

questions.text: Why do people like watching the sunset or the stars?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you saw a beautiful sky, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all nature around us. Why do people like watching the sunset or the stars?

questions.text: Do people in cities notice nature less than people in the countryside?
questions.say: Do people in cities notice nature less than people in the countryside?

questions.text: How does light pollution affect people and animals?
questions.say: How does light pollution affect people and animals?

questions.text: Should countries spend money on exploring space?
questions.say: Now let's talk about space exploration. Should countries spend money on exploring space?

questions.text: Would you like to see people live on another planet one day?
questions.say: Would you like to see people live on another planet one day?

questions.text: What can we learn from studying space?
questions.say: What can we learn from studying space?
